Message:
Enforce admin subdomain and improve routing for admin portal (#125)

* chore: add .worktrees/ to .gitignore

* feat(auth): enforce admin.boardsmart.xyz subdomain for admin portal

Admin routes are now only reachable at admin.boardsmart.xyz:
- Fund subdomains hitting /admin/* get a hard 404
- Apex domain hitting /admin/* gets a 302 redirect to admin.boardsmart.xyz
- admin.boardsmart.xyz blocks non-admin/non-auth/non-static routes
- /sign-in works at admin.boardsmart.xyz so Sara can authenticate

Adds reserved-slug protection so no fund can be onboarded with a
subdomain/client_id that collides with infrastructure subdomains
(admin, www, api, scorecard, health, static). Enforced at application
layer in executeUpsertClient and at DB layer via CHECK constraints.
